title: Make it easier to connect to recent Bluetooth devices
line: The Bluetooth widget has a search field that filters paired devices by name or address.
explanation: With many paired devices the Bluetooth widget only offered a long alphabetical list, so finding a device meant scrolling and skimming it. There was no way to narrow the list down. The change adds a search field to the widget's toolbar, like the Networks widget has, which filters the list by device name or Bluetooth address (case-insensitive) and shows "No matches" when nothing fits; the search is cleared when the popup closes.

commits.message:
applet: add a search field to filter devices

With many paired devices, finding one meant scrolling and skimming the
whole list. A search field in the toolbar now filters the list by device
name or address, and shows a "No matches" message when nothing matches.

BUG: 516932

review.text: Clean, well-structured implementation of the Bluetooth applet search field across DevicesProxyModel, Toolbar.qml, and FullRepresentation.qml. It filters paired devices case-insensitively by device name or MAC address using setFilterFixedString (avoiding regex pitfalls and leaving KCM/unpaired usage unaffected), clears on popup close, supports Down-arrow navigation into the list, and shows a localized 'No matches' placeholder. Directly fulfills the core usability wish and matches Nate's recommended direction without fragile kded connection-history tracking.

reviews.text: Clean, well-structured implementation of the Bluetooth applet search field across DevicesProxyModel, Toolbar.qml, and FullRepresentation.qml. It filters paired devices case-insensitively by device name or MAC address using setFilterFixedString (avoiding regex pitfalls and leaving KCM/unpaired usage unaffected), clears on popup close, supports Down-arrow navigation into the list, and shows a localized 'No matches' placeholder. Directly fulfills the core usability wish and matches Nate's recommended direction without fragile kded connection-history tracking.

The search field itself is well done: filtering in DevicesProxyModel by name or address, Networks-style toolbar SearchField, a 'No matches' placeholder, clearing on collapse and Down-key navigation; screenshots prove it, and Nate called option (c) a no-brainer. But the bug, as titled ('Make it easier to connect to recent Bluetooth devices') and described, is mainly about recently used devices: the reporter prefers (b)+(c) and also complains about the list jumping when connecting, and Nate (c1, c4) agreed to a recent-devices section shown only with more than about 6 devices, following the c3 design. Search alone covers only part of it, so BUG: 516932 would close the report with its main request still open.
changes: Either add the recent-devices part (a 'Recent' section/dropdown at the top shown only when the list scrolls or there are more than ~6 paired devices, per c1/c3/c4; recency can be tracked in bluedevil's kded or the applet since BlueZ doesn't store it), or switch the commit to CCBUG: 516932 and submit the search field as a partial improvement
Optionally forward typed text from the popup to the search field (like the Networks widget) so typing right after opening the popup filters straight away
